inputs.goal: Discover the Kubernetes cluster resources, deploy a MiniCluster of the same number of nodes and maximum cores available to the default namespace. Use the container ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:laghos. Run cube_311_hex.mesh with laghos in the pwd. You MUST maximize the Major kernels total rate (megadofs x time steps / second). You can add additional parameters to achieve that goal. If the run is successful, parse the log and get the FOM. If not, keep trying to deploy until it is fixed. Keep going until you deem optimized and return all FOMs you have parsed.

inputs.manifest:
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: minicluster-1
spec:
  size: 1
  tasks: 64
  flux:
    arch: aarch64
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:laghos
      command: laghos -p 1 -m cube_311_hex.mesh

outputs.summary: Successfully optimized the MiniCluster by adjusting the number of tasks. The initial run with 64 tasks yielded a FOM of 133.73. Adding the '-pa' flag decreased performance to 128.75. Halving the tasks to 32 increased the FOM to 139.79. A further reduction to 16 tasks dropped the FOM significantly to 108.18. The optimal configuration found was with 32 tasks.
